assertions.assertion: The denial was issued under CARC code CO-97.
The service at issue is CPT 93271.
CPT 93271 corresponds to a cardiac event monitoring study.
The claim relates to episode ep-05084.
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness.
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation.
The patient has a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.
The diagnosis codes are Z86.73, G45.9, and I48.0.
The clinical indication note is the source of the quoted clinical statement.
The study is ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of these transient cerebral ischemic events.
The study is ordered to guide anticoagulation management.
